comments: Information of tracklisting from Hal C F Astell's website. Part of this show is now up on Mixcloud.

Special show dedicated to the memory of Phil Lynott, who died on 4 Jan 1986. It features interview footage and Thin Lizzy songs. The playout music is Theme One, as used on the Friday Night Connection and Lie Back And Enjoy It.
